dorsal_wing_plumage_topography.flight_feather_edge_geometry: Clearly visible pale fringes on the outer vanes of folded flight feathers, showing sharp boundary contrast against dark grey-brown centers.

crown_and_nape_macro_patterns.nape_patch_geometry: A broad, triangular region of high-contrast dark crescentic markings on a pale background, extending from the base of the crown down to the upper mantle.
crown_and_nape_macro_patterns.crown_to_mantle_demarcation: A distinct, linear boundary where the uniform brownish-tan crown plumage terminates and the high-contrast scaly pattern of the nape begins.

other_distinctive_markers: Highly distinctive scaly plumage pattern across the upper back and scapulars consisting of dark-centered feathers with broad, pale-buff marginal fringes.
